narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran the same. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice} and the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. That same month, {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, the measure of how much pay is claimed before it arrives. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. More of each month's pay was spoken for in the ghost's life, where Freedom finished {freedom_gap}.
